title: Appointment Letter Template
description: Free appointment letter format for India with designation, CTC break-up, probation, working hours, notice period, terms and employee acceptance. Use it in Word, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Excel or Overleaf.
features: Designation, joining date, location and reporting manager
Monthly and annual CTC break-up with employer PF
Probation, notice, leave and confidentiality terms with acceptance
useCases: Confirming a new hire after the offer letter
Startups and SMEs formalising employment terms
research: References agree on a reference number and date, designation, joining date, place of posting, annual CTC with a salary break-up annexure, probation (usually 3-6 months), working hours, leave, notice period, confidentiality, company policies and a signed employee acceptance.

lines: [Plot 42, Industrial Area Phase II, Pune, Maharashtra 411019]
blocks.title: APPOINTMENT LETTER

text: Further to our offer letter and your acceptance, we are pleased to appoint you as **[Senior Software Engineer]** in the **[Product Engineering]** department of [Sharma IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.], on the terms set out below. Your appointment is effective from your date of joining.

blocks.heading: Terms and conditions
text: 1. **Probation:** you will be on probation for [6 months]. On satisfactory performance you will receive a written confirmation; the probation may be extended once by up to [3 months].
2. **Notice period:** [15 days] during probation and [60 days] after confirmation, from either side, or salary in lieu of notice.
3. **Leave:** you are entitled to [18 days] of earned leave, [7 days] of casual/sick leave and declared holidays each year, as per the leave policy.
4. **Deductions:** salary is paid monthly after PF, professional tax and income tax (TDS) as applicable by law.
5. **Confidentiality:** you will keep all company and client information confidential during and after your employment and follow the company's code of conduct and policies.
6. **Documents:** this appointment is subject to verification of your educational, identity and previous employment documents.
Please sign and return a copy of this letter as your acceptance. We welcome you to the team and wish you a rewarding career with us.

items: [Neha Kulkarni], Head - HR, for [Sharma IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.]
